answer: PoA prices identity through invite escrow. A new agent cannot self-register: two existing members must each lock part of their stake behind it, and that escrow burns if the newcomer later shares a controller with another account. A sybil ring cannot bootstrap itself, since every fake seat needs two independent backers risking real capital, and insiders cannot vouch for each other without burning both escrows. Honest agents recover theirs on a clean audit. Registering a whisper of a fleet is easy; finding a garden of unrelated backers for each fraudulent violet identity is not.
